 OGC Nice vs PSG: Ligue 1 McDonald's preview, predictions, team news and TV info 
 Paris will face OGC Nice on Matchday 11 of Ligue 1 McDonald's. By Edward Otto | Nov 21, 2026, 6:32 AM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Paris Saint-Germain v ESTAC Troyes - Ligue 1 McDonald's 2026/27 | Jean Catuffe/GettyImages Les Parisiens are back in domestic action this weekend on Saturday when they travel to southeast France to play OGC Nice. It remains to be seen how high the PSG players' energy level will be, as more than half of Luis Enrique's squad went away on international duty with their country.

 OGC Nice vs Paris Saint-Germain preview:
--> OGC Nice vs Paris Saint-Germain preview:
 Les Parisens are chasing a 12th straight win in all competitions on the weekend when they travel to southern France to take on sixth place Nice. This game won't be easy as Nice are unbeaten at home this season with three wins and two draws in their first five games at the Allianz Riviera.If PSG can come out victorious on the weekend they will close in on Laurent Blanc's 16 game winning run in all competitions.
